passage.py: Máshěnglǐgōngxuéyuàn de Suōluó jiàoshòu zhǐchū, zài guòqù, wúlùn shìfǒu yōngyǒu zhuānmén jìshù, zhǐyào shēng zài fùyù guójiā de rén, jiù néng nádào jiàogāo de xīnshuǐ.
passage.en: Professor Thurow of MIT points out that in the past, whether or not they had specialized skills, people born in rich countries could get higher wages.

passage.zh: 這是由於過去的經濟環境較封閉，當國內找不到人手，即使是技術不足的勞工，也能要求高薪資。
passage.py: Zhè shì yóuyú guòqù de jīngjì huánjìng jiào fēngbì, dāng guónèi zhǎo búdào rénshǒu, jíshǐ shì jìshù bùzú de láogōng, yě néng yāoqiú gāo xīnzī.
passage.en: This is because the economic environment used to be more closed; when workers couldn't be found at home, even workers with insufficient skills could demand high wages.

passage.zh: 然而在全球化的時代，國內缺乏勞工，可轉而從海外引進，如此一來，低技術的工作機會便轉移到海外其他國家。
passage.py: Ránér zài quánqiúhuà de shídài, guónèi quēfá láogōng, kě zhuǎnér cóng hǎiwài yǐnjìn, rúcǐyìlái, dī jìshù de gōngzuò jīhuì biàn zhuǎnyí dào hǎiwài qítā guójiā.
passage.en: But in the age of globalization, when there's a shortage of workers at home, they can be brought in from overseas instead; in this way, low-skill jobs move to other countries abroad.

passage.zh: 於是，富裕國家中那些缺乏專業技術的勞工，就得面臨薪資下降甚至失業的危機。
passage.py: Yúshì, fùyù guójiā zhōng nàxiē quēfá zhuānyè jìshù de láogōng, jiù dé miànlín xīnzī xiàjiàng shènzhì shīyè de wēijī.
passage.en: So workers in rich countries who lack specialized skills face falling wages or even unemployment.

passage.zh: 在這種情況下，多半富裕國家會透過社會福利制度提供補助，以幫助弱勢勞工，不過這也會大幅增加財政支出，對國家造成不小的負擔。
passage.py: Zài zhèzhǒng qíngkuàng xià, duōbàn fùyù guójiā huì tòuguò shèhuì fúlìzhìdù tígōng bǔzhù, yǐ bāngzhù ruòshì láogōng, búguò zhè yě huì dàfú zēngjiā cáizhèngzhīchū, duì guójiā zàochéng bùxiǎo de fùdān.
passage.en: In this situation, most rich countries provide subsidies through social welfare systems to help disadvantaged workers, but this also greatly increases government spending and places no small burden on the country.

passage.en: Recently we often see similar news on TV and in the papers: a foreigner traveling in Taiwan accidentally loses a huge sum of travel money, but fortunately a kind-hearted driver or passer-by always returns the money to its owner, and the foreign traveler gives a thumbs-up, praising Taiwanese people's honesty.

passage.zh: 這樣的新聞雖然能對社會產生正面的影響，但也不得不讓人進一步思量：拾金不昧的消息屢屢登上新聞版面，是不是也代表這類行為已經不再被人們視為理所當然？
passage.py: Zhèyàng de xīnwén suīrán néng duì shèhuì chǎnshēng zhèngmiàn de yǐngxiǎng, dàn yě bùdébù ràng rén jìnyíbù sīliáng: Shíjīnbúmèi de xiāoxī lǚlǚ dēngshàng xīnwén bǎnmiàn, shìbúshì yě dàibiǎo zhè lèi xíngwéi yǐjīng búzài bèi rénmen shìwèi lǐsuǒdāngrán?
passage.en: Although such news can have a positive effect on society, it also makes one think further: does the fact that stories of returning lost money keep making the news mean that such behavior is no longer taken for granted?

passage.zh: 換句話說，在現今社會中，撿到別人遺失的金錢、物品而據為己有的人也不在少數。
passage.py: Huànjùhuàshuō, zài xiànjīn shèhuì zhōng, jiǎn dào biérén yíshī de jīnqián, wùpǐn ér jùwéijǐyǒu de rén yě búzàishǎoshù.
passage.en: In other words, in today's society there are quite a few people who keep money and things they find that others have lost.

passage.zh: 如此看來，看到這類新聞，我們實在不用太高興。
passage.py: Rúcǐ kànlái, kàndào zhè lèi xīnwén, wǒmen shízài búyòng Tàigāoxìng.
passage.en: Seen this way, we really shouldn't be too pleased when we see this kind of news.

passage.zh: 如果有那麼一天，拾金不昧不再是新聞，而那些不願物歸原主、愛占人便宜的人，反而登上新聞版面，這才代表拾金不昧已經成為我們社會裡自然流露的美德。
passage.py: Rúguǒ yǒu nàme yìtiān, shíjīnbúmèi búzài shì xīnwén, ér nàxiē bù yuàn wùguīyuánzhǔ, ài zhàn rén piányi de rén, fǎnér dēngshàng xīnwén bǎnmiàn, zhè cái dàibiǎo shíjīnbúmèi yǐjīng chéngwéi wǒmen shèhuì lǐ zìrán liúlù de Měidé.
passage.en: If one day returning lost money is no longer news, and instead those who won't return things and like to take advantage of others make the news, only then will it mean that returning lost property has become a virtue that comes naturally in our society.

passage.zh: 「風水」與建築息息相關，是建築師在設計中經常遇到的問題，美籍華裔設計師貝聿銘設計的香港中銀大廈所遇到的「風水風波」就是一個最典型的事例。
passage.py: “Fēngshuǐ” yǔ jiànzhù xīxīxiāngguān, shì jiànzhùshī zài shèjì zhōng jīngcháng yùdào de wèntí, měijí Huáyì shèjìshī Bèiyùmíng shèjì de Xiānggǎng Zhōngyín dàshà suǒ yùdào de “Fēngshuǐ fēngbō” jiùshì yí ge zuì diǎnxíng de shìlì.
passage.en: "Feng shui" is closely related to architecture and is a problem architects often meet in their designs. The "feng shui controversy" over Hong Kong's Bank of China Tower, designed by Chinese-American architect I. M. Pei, is the most typical example.

passage.zh: 這棟建築的鋼架是個巨大的「X」，這個符號在中華文化中意味著「遭殃」，只有罪犯名字上才會出現。
passage.py: Zhèdòng jiànzhù de gāngjià shì gè jùdà de “X”, zhè ge fúhào zài Zhōnghuáwénhuà zhōng yìwèizhù “Zāoyāng”, zhǐyǒu zuìfàn míngzi shàngcái huì chūxiàn.
passage.en: The building's steel frame forms a giant "X," a symbol that in Chinese culture means "disaster" and only appears on criminals' names.

passage.zh: 風波爆發後，貝聿銘將這個符號巧妙地隱藏了起來，用類似佛教吉祥標誌的建物蓋住，這才皆大歡喜。
passage.py: Fēngbō bàofā hòu, Bèiyùmíng jiāng zhè ge fúhào qiǎomiào dì yǐncáng le qǐlái, yòng lèisì Fójiào Jíxiáng biāozhì de jiànwù gàizhù, zhè cái jiēdàhuānxǐ.
passage.en: After the controversy broke out, Pei cleverly hid the symbol, covering it with a structure resembling an auspicious Buddhist emblem, and only then was everyone happy.

passage.zh: 另外，該大廈的外形像一把刀也引發了不少爭議，其中一面「刀鋒」直指港督府（今香港禮賓府），總督請風水學家來化解，決定在面朝中銀大廈一側種植柳樹以阻擋殺氣。
passage.py: Lìngwài, gāi dàshà de wàixíng xiàng yìbǎ dāo yě yǐnfā le bùshǎo zhēngyì, qízhōng yímiàn “Dāofēng” zhízhǐ gǎngdū Fǔ (Jīn Xiānggǎng lǐbīnfǔ), zǒngdū qǐng fēngshuǐ xuéjiā lái huàjiě, juédìng zài miàncháo Zhōngyín dàshà yícè zhòngzhí Liǔshù yǐ zǔdǎng shāqì.
passage.en: In addition, the building's shape, like a knife, also caused much controversy: one "blade" pointed directly at Government House (the governor's residence). The governor invited a feng shui master to neutralize it, and it was decided to plant willow trees on the side facing the Bank of China Tower to block the "killing energy."

passage.zh: 除此之外，附近的滙豐銀行也正好與此刀鋒相對，使銀行業績受到嚴重影響，於是滙豐銀行便在自家樓頂加裝兩座對著中銀大廈的砲台，用這種特殊的道具來反制對方的殺氣，業績才逐漸好轉。
passage.py: Chúcǐzhīwài, fùjìn de Huìfēngyínháng yě zhènghǎo yǔ cǐ dāofēng xiāngduì, shǐ yínháng yèjì shòudào yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng, yúshì Huìfēngyínháng biàn zài zìjiā lóudǐng jiāzhuāng liǎngzuò duìzhù Zhōngyín dàshà de pào tái, yòng zhèzhǒng tèshū de dàojù lái fǎnzhì duìfāng de shāqì, yèjì cái zhújiàn hǎozhuǎn.
passage.en: Besides that, the nearby HSBC building happened to face the blade too, and the bank's business was seriously affected. So HSBC installed two cannons on its own roof pointing at the Bank of China Tower, using this special prop to counter the other side's killing energy, and its business gradually improved.

passage.zh: 除建築造型外，室內擺設也是風水學關注的重點。
passage.py: Chú jiànzhùzàoxíng wài, shìnèi bǎishè yě shì fēngshuǐxué guānzhù de zhòngdiǎn.
passage.en: Besides a building's shape, interior furnishings are also a focus of feng shui.

passage.zh: 改變居家風水的典型道具有畫、植物、風鈴、鏡子等，只要在合適的地方擺放這類道具，就能改善運勢。
passage.py: Gǎibiàn jūjiā fēngshuǐ de diǎnxíng dào jùyǒu huà, zhíwù, fēnglíng, jìngzi děng, zhǐyào zài héshì de dìfāng bǎifàng zhè lèi dàojù, jiù néng gǎishàn yùnshì.
passage.en: Typical props for changing a home's feng shui include paintings, plants, wind chimes and mirrors; just placing such items in the right places can improve your fortune.

passage.zh: 以畫來說，山水畫最常見，水代表財富，因此客廳擺放山水畫時，必須注意畫中水流方向不可朝向屋外，最好是朝向主臥房；
passage.py: Yǐ huà láishuō, shānshuǐhuà zuì chángjiàn, shuǐ dàibiǎo cáifù, yīncǐ kètīng bǎifàng shānshuǐhuà shí, bìxū zhùyì huà zhōng shuǐliú fāngxiàng bùkě cháoxiàng wūwài, zuìhǎo shì cháoxiàng zhǔ wòfáng;
passage.en: Among paintings, landscape paintings are the most common. Water represents wealth, so when hanging a landscape painting in the living room, make sure the water in the painting doesn't flow toward the outside of the house—ideally it should flow toward the master bedroom;

passage.zh: 另外，辦公室常見的盆栽也是改變運勢的好幫手，能夠扭轉乾坤並帶來好運的盆栽如金錢竹、蘭花等，當這些植物的花謝了、葉枯了，一定得立即更換，好運才能延續。
passage.py: Lìngwài, bàngōngshì chángjiàn de pénzāi yě shì gǎibiàn yùnshì de hǎobāngshǒu, nénggòu niǔzhuǎnqiánkūn bìng dàilái hǎoyùn de pénzāi rú jīnqián zhú, Lánhuā děng, dāng zhèxiē zhíwù de huāxiè le, yè kū le, yídìng dé lìjí gēnghuàn, hǎoyùn cáinéng yánxù.
passage.en: in addition, the potted plants common in offices are also good helpers for changing your fortune. Plants that can turn things around and bring good luck include lucky bamboo and orchids; when these plants' flowers fade or leaves wither, they must be replaced immediately for the good luck to continue.

image.zh: 氣候及環境：菱角原生於歐洲與亞洲，一般栽種於池塘或沼澤地。氣溫不宜過冷，最佳在攝氏25度至36度，水深要有60公分。

image.en: Climate and environment: The water caltrop is native to Europe and Asia and is usually grown in ponds or marshes. The temperature shouldn't be too cold—ideally 25 to 36°C—and the water should be 60 cm deep.

image.zh: 在中國南方，稻田在第一期收割完成後，經常接著栽種菱角幼苗，並在水田中放養泥鰍或淡水魚以增加收入。
image.py: Zài Zhōngguó nánfāng, dàotián zài dìyìqī shōugē wánchéng hòu, jīngcháng jiēzhù zāizhòng língjiǎo yòumiáo, bìng zài shuǐtián zhōng fàngyǎng níqiū huò dànshuǐyú yǐ zēngjiāshōurù.
image.en: In southern China, after the first rice harvest, water caltrop seedlings are often planted in the paddies, and loaches or freshwater fish are raised in them to increase income.

image.zh: 收穫：農夫從種下菱角幼苗到菱角開花結果收成，通常需要90到120天。採收後依菱角的重量篩選，重者為優品。
image.py: Shōuhuò: Nóngfū cóng zhǒng xià língjiǎo yòumiáo dào língjiǎo kāihuājiéguǒ shōuchéng, tōngcháng xūyào 90 dào 120 tiān. Cǎishōu hòu yī língjiǎo de zhòngliàng shāixuǎn, zhòngzhě wèi yōupǐn.
image.en: Harvest: From planting the seedlings to flowering, fruiting and harvest usually takes 90 to 120 days. After harvesting, the caltrops are sorted by weight; heavier ones are top grade.

image.zh: 一株幼苗大約可結80朵花，每朵花通常會結出8到12個果實，也就是我們所食用的菱角。總體來說，菱角產量相當大。
image.py: Yìzhū yòumiáo dàyuē kějié 80 duǒhuā, měi duǒhuā tōngcháng huì jiéchū 8 dào 12 gè guǒshí, yě jiùshì wǒmen suǒ shíyòng de língjiǎo. Zǒngtǐ láishuō, língjiǎo chǎnliàng xiāngdāng dà.
image.en: One seedling can produce about 80 flowers, and each flower usually bears 8 to 12 fruits—the water caltrops we eat. Overall, the yield is quite large.

image.zh: 花朵：花朵顏色為白色，體積不大，但特性和有「太陽花」之稱的向日葵一樣，花朵會自然地面朝太陽，所以上午時花朵面朝東，傍晚時則面朝西。
image.py: Huāduǒ: Huāduǒ yánsè wèi báisè, tǐjī bù dà, dàn tèxìng hé yǒu “Tàiyáng huā” zhī chēng de xiàngrìkuí yíyàng, huāduǒ huì zìrán dìmiàn Cháo Tàiyáng, suǒyǐ shàngwǔ shí huāduǒ miàncháo Dōng, bàngwǎn shízé miàncháo xī.
image.en: Flowers: The flowers are white and small, but like the sunflower, known as the "sun flower," they naturally face the sun—so in the morning they face east and in the evening west.

image.zh: 不過，有別於鮮黃耀眼的向日葵能輕易地捕捉眾人目光，菱角白皙的小花像是靜靜的少女，不爭奇鬥豔，正因平凡、不醒目，也就能保護自己不被隨便摘折。
image.py: Búguò, yǒubiéyú xiānhuáng yàoyǎn de xiàngrìkuí néng qīngyì dì bǔzhuō zhòngrén mùguāng, língjiǎo Báixī de xiǎohuā xiàngshì jìngjìngde shàonǚ, bù zhēngqídòuyàn, zhèng yīn píngfán, bù xǐngmù, yě jiù néng bǎohù zìjǐ bù bèi suíbiàn zhāizhé.
image.en: However, unlike the bright yellow sunflower that easily catches everyone's eye, the caltrop's small white flower is like a quiet young girl that doesn't compete for attention; precisely because it is plain and inconspicuous, it protects itself from being casually picked.

passage.en: Dengue fever is one of Taiwan's most serious infectious diseases in summer, and its main vector is the mosquito.

passage.zh: I 目前政府防範登革熱的方法是宣導民眾清除積水的容器，並在疫情緊急時噴灑藥劑以消滅病媒蚊。

passage.en: I The government's current method of preventing dengue is to urge people to remove containers of standing water, and to spray insecticide to kill vector mosquitoes when outbreaks are urgent.

passage.zh: II 然而，由於民眾自己也會買殺蟲劑噴藥，政府和民眾噴的藥互相干擾，使得病媒蚊產生更強的抗藥性。
passage.py: II ránér, yóuyú mínzhòng zìjǐ yě huì mǎi shāchóngjì pēnyào, zhèngfǔ hé mínzhòng pēn de yào hùxiāng gānrǎo, shǐde bìngméi wén chǎnshēng gèng qiáng de Kàngyàoxìng.
passage.en: II However, because people also buy insecticide and spray it themselves, the government's and the public's sprays interfere with each other, giving vector mosquitoes even stronger resistance.

passage.zh: III 這情形使得目前常用的殺蟲劑只剩下一、兩種有效。
passage.py: III zhè qíngxíng shǐde mùqián chángyòng de shāchóngjì zhǐ shèngxià yī, liǎngzhǒng yǒuxiào.
passage.en: III As a result, only one or two of the commonly used insecticides are still effective.

passage.zh: 正因為噴灑藥劑會使病媒蚊產生抗藥性，防治效果不佳，不少科學家便嘗試以基因重組的方式來改變蚊子的生理構造，如改變蚊子的嗅覺受器，讓牠們聞不到人類的氣味；
passage.py: Zhèng yīnwèi pēnsǎ yàojì huì shǐ bìngméi wén chǎnshēng Kàngyàoxìng, fángzhìxiàoguǒ bù jiā, bùshǎo kēxuéjiā biàn chángshì yǐ jīyīn chóngzǔ de fāngshì lái gǎibiàn wénzi de shēnglǐ gòuzào, rú gǎibiàn wénzi de xiùjué shòuqì, ràng tā men wén búdào rénlèi de qìwèi;
passage.en: Precisely because spraying insecticide makes vector mosquitoes resistant and control is ineffective, many scientists have tried using genetic recombination to change mosquitoes' physiology, for example changing their olfactory receptors so they can't smell humans;

passage.zh: 或是在實驗室中培育出抵抗力弱的蚊蟲，再將牠們釋放到野外，當牠們與野外蚊蟲交配，便會生下缺乏抵抗力、死亡率高的後代；
passage.py: Huòshì zài shíyànshì zhōng péiyùchū dǐkànglì ruò de wénchóng, zài jiāng tā men shìfàng dào yěwài, dāng tā men yǔ yěwài wénchóng jiāopèi, biàn huì shēngxià quēfá dǐkànglì, sǐwánglǜ gāo de hòudài;
passage.en: or breeding mosquitoes with weak resistance in the lab and releasing them into the wild, so that when they mate with wild mosquitoes they produce offspring that lack resistance and have high death rates;

passage.zh: 甚至還可以透過基因改造，使雌蚊的翅膀肌肉退化，一旦雌蚊無法飛行，便容易死亡，降低散播病毒的機率。
passage.py: Shènzhì hái kěyǐ tòuguò jīyīn gǎizào, shǐ cí wén de chìbǎng jīròu tuìhuà, yídàn cí wén wúfǎ fēixíng, biàn róngyì sǐwáng, jiàngdī sànbō bìngdú de jīlǜ.
passage.en: genetic modification can even make female mosquitoes' wing muscles degenerate; once females can't fly they die easily, lowering the chance of spreading the virus.

passage.zh: 可惜上述種種想法都還在實驗階段，因為這些方法可能會影響食物鏈、破壞生態。
passage.py: Kěxī shàngshù zhǒngzhǒng xiǎngfǎ dōu hái zài shíyàn jiēduàn, yīnwèi zhèxiē fāngfǎ kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng shíwùliàn, pòhuài shēngtài.
passage.en: Unfortunately all these ideas are still at the experimental stage, because these methods might affect the food chain and damage the ecosystem.

passage.en: The more feasible method at present is to control vector mosquitoes with natural enemies, for example raising tadpoles in ponds. Tadpoles are young frogs and feed on mosquito larvae, which helps prevent mosquitoes from breeding;

passage.zh: 不過，當蝌蚪長成青蛙後，會引來牠們的天敵──蛇。
passage.py: Búguò, dāng kēdǒu zhǎngchéng qīngwā hòu, huì yǐnlái tā men de tiāndí ─ ─ shé.

passage.py: Dàn měizhōngbùzú de shì, dàdù yú zhǐnéng cúnhuó zài jiào qīngjié de shuǐyù, qiě gānzào, quēyǎng, shíwù bùzú jiē kě dǎozhì qí sǐwáng, yào huā jiào duō rénlì zhàogù.

passage.py: Jiéguǒ fāxiàn, jìyì qīwèishù zhě xiāngjiào yú jìyì dānyī shùzì zhě, gèng róngyì jiāng suāndù gāo de níngméngzhī pàndìng wèi “Bù suān”.
passage.en: They found that those memorizing seven digits were more likely than those memorizing a single digit to judge highly acidic lemon juice as "not sour."

passage.zh: 該項實驗顯示，當認知負荷較高時，人們對於味道的敏銳度可能降低。
passage.py: Gāixiàng shíyàn xiǎnshì, dāng rènzhī fùhè jiào gāo shí, rénmen duìyú wèidào de mǐnruìdù kěnéng jiàngdī.
passage.en: This experiment shows that when cognitive load is higher, people's sensitivity to taste may decrease.

passage.zh: 研究人員另一項以判定糖漿水甜度為指標所進行的實驗，也得出了相似的結論。
passage.py: Yánjiū rényuán lìng yíxiàng yǐ pàndìng tángjiāng shuǐ tiándù wèi zhǐbiāo suǒ jìnxíng de shíyàn, yě déchū le xiāngsì de jiélùn.
passage.en: Another experiment by the researchers, using the sweetness of syrup water as the measure, reached a similar conclusion.

passage.zh: 隨後，研究人員嘗試改變測量方式，他們觀察並記錄實驗參與者吃下多少含鹽、不含鹽的奶油。
passage.py: Suíhòu, yánjiū rényuán chángshì gǎibiàn cèliáng fāngshì, tāmen guānchá bìng jìlù shíyàn cānyùzhě chī xià duōshǎo hányán, bù hányán de nǎiyóu.
passage.en: The researchers then tried changing the measurement method: they observed and recorded how much salted and unsalted butter participants ate.

passage.zh: 爾後發現，認知負荷量偏高時，人們會攝取較多含鹽的奶油。
passage.py: Ěrhòu fāxiàn, rènzhī fùhèliàng piān gāo shí, rénmen huì shèqǔ jiào duō hányán de nǎiyóu.
passage.en: They found that when cognitive load was high, people ate more salted butter.

passage.zh: 而在又一項實驗中，研究者請參與者自行調配他們理想中的檸檬汁(混合檸檬水和糖漿)，同樣在認知負荷較高時，實驗參與者加入了較多的糖漿。
passage.py: Ér zài yòu yíxiàng shíyàn zhōng, yánjiūzhě qǐng cānyùzhě zìxíng diàopèi tāmen lǐxiǎng zhōng de níngméngzhī (Hùnhé níngméngshuǐ hé tángjiāng), tóngyàng zài rènzhī fùhè jiào gāo shí, shíyàn cānyùzhě jiārù le jiàoduō de tángjiāng.
passage.en: And in yet another experiment, researchers asked participants to mix their own ideal lemonade (combining lemon water and syrup); again, under higher cognitive load, participants added more syrup.

passage.zh: 以上研究從幾種不同的觀察角度， I 證實了認知負荷量對於味覺的影響。
passage.py: Yǐshàng yánjiū cóng jǐzhǒng bùtóng de guānchá jiǎodù, I zhèngshí le rènzhī fùhèliàng duìyú wèijué de yǐngxiǎng.
passage.en: The studies above, from several different angles, ___I___ confirm the effect of cognitive load on taste.

passage.zh: 認知負荷高， II 人們會偏好口味較重、濃郁的東西。
passage.py: Rènzhī fùhè gāo, II rénmen huì piānhǎo kǒuwèi jiào zhòng, nóngyù de Dōngxi.
passage.en: When cognitive load is high, ___II___ people prefer stronger, richer flavors.

passage.zh: 這個結果似乎與現實生活中的情境十分相符，一些崇尚健康、養生的人，粗茶淡飯也覺得很美味，特別是一些長期茹素的僧侶等，生活的平靜讓他們安於清淡的食物。
passage.py: Zhè ge jiéguǒ sìhū yǔ xiànshíshēnghuó zhōng de qíngjìng shífēn xiāngfú, yìxiē Chóngshàng jiànkāng, yǎngshēng de rén, cūchádànfàn yě juéde hěn Měiwèi, tèbié shì yìxiē chángqī Rúsù de sēnglǚ děng, shēnghuó de píngjìng ràng tāmen ānyú qīngdàn de shíwù.
passage.en: This result seems to fit real-life situations very well: some people who value health and wellness find even plain, simple food delicious—especially monks who have been vegetarian for a long time, whose calm lives make them content with light food.

passage.zh: III 反觀現代忙碌的都巿人， IV 往往選擇偏甜、偏鹹，或較為刺激性的食物來滿足自己的味蕾，如此看來，確有其理據。
passage.py: III fǎnguān xiàndài mánglù de dōu fú rén, IV wǎngwǎng xuǎnzé piān tián, piān xián, huò jiàowéi cìjīxìng de shíwù lái mǎnzú zìjǐ de wèilěi, rúcǐ kànlái, quèyǒu qí lǐjù.
passage.en: ___III___ By contrast, busy modern city dwellers ___IV___ often choose sweeter, saltier or more stimulating food to satisfy their taste buds; seen this way, there is indeed a basis for it.

passage.zh: 澳洲國立大學人類學家基普尼斯日前出版一本關於中國對教育極端重視的著作。
passage.py: Àozhōu Guólìdàxué rénlèixuéjiā Jīpǔ Nísī rìqián chūbǎn yìběn guānyú Zhōngguó duì jiàoyù jíduān zhòngshì de zhùzuò.
passage.en: Kipnis, an anthropologist at the Australian National University, recently published a book about China's extreme emphasis on education.

passage.zh: 他表示，中國人在教育方面的支出「高得越來越離譜」。
passage.py: Tā biǎoshì, Zhōngguó rén zài jiàoyù fāngmiàn de zhīchū “Gāo dé yuèláiyuè lípǔ”.
passage.en: He says Chinese spending on education is "getting more and more outrageously high."

passage.zh: 會如此捨得的不只有中產階級家庭，勞工階級也視「接受教育」為未來能確保孩子社會地位的唯一途徑。
passage.py: Huì rúcǐ shěde de bù zhǐyǒu zhōngchǎnjiējí jiātíng, láogōngjiējí yě shì “Jiēshòu jiàoyù” wèi wèilái néng quèbǎo háizi shèhuì dìwèi de wéiyī tújìng.
passage.en: It's not only middle-class families who are so willing to spend; the working class also see "getting an education" as the only way to secure their children's future social status.

passage.zh: 為了使子女過得比自己更好，有些人因此深陷負債的泥沼之中。
passage.py: Wèile shǐ zǐnǚ guò dé bǐ zìjǐ gènghǎo, yǒuxiē rén yīncǐ shēnxiàn fùzhài de nízhǎo zhīzhōng.
passage.en: To make their children's lives better than their own, some people sink deep into a quagmire of debt.

passage.zh: 基普尼斯表示，許多鄉村地區的父母不願接受醫療服務，寧可把錢花在子女的教育上，甚至不惜向親戚借錢。
passage.py: Jīpǔ Nísī biǎoshì, xǔduō xiāngcūn dìqū de fùmǔ bù yuàn jiēshòu yīliáo fúwù, Nìngkě bǎ qián huā zài zǐnǚ de jiàoyù shàng, shènzhì bùxī xiàng qīnqī jièqián.
passage.en: Kipnis says many parents in rural areas refuse medical services, preferring to spend the money on their children's education, even borrowing from relatives.

passage.zh: 據歐睿研究調查中心的調查，2008 年至 2012 年間，中國人的平均所得提高了 63.3％，而其中在教育方面的花費竟增加了近九成五。
passage.py: Jù Ōuruì yánjiū diàochá zhōngxīn de diàochá, 2008 nián zhì 2012 niánjiān, Zhōngguó rén de píngjūn suǒde tígāo le 63.3 ％, ér qízhōng zài jiàoyù fāngmiàn de huāfèi jìng zēngjiā le jìnjiǔchéng wǔ.
passage.en: According to a survey by Euromonitor, between 2008 and 2012 average income in China rose 63.3%, while spending on education rose by nearly 95%.

passage.zh: 這種「教育狂熱」迫使家有學子的家庭不得不錙銖必較、慎重思考家庭經費的支用。
passage.py: Zhèzhǒng “Jiàoyù kuángrè” pòshǐ jiā yǒu xuézǐ de jiātíng bùdébù zīzhūbìjiào, shènzhòng sīkǎo jiātíng jīngfèi de zhīyòng.
passage.en: This "education fever" forces families with students to count every penny and think carefully about how to spend the household budget.

passage.zh: 不過，某些家庭的收支分配有時相當具有戲劇性，譬如將僅有的公寓售出，只為了籌款讓子女喝洋墨水。
passage.py: Búguò, mǒuxiē jiātíng de shōuzhī fēnpèi yǒushí xiāngdāng jùyǒu xìjùxìng, pìrú jiāng jǐn yǒu de gōngyù shòuchū, zhǐ wèile chóukuǎn ràng zǐnǚ hē yángmòshuǐ.
passage.en: However, some families' allocation of income and spending is quite dramatic, such as selling their only apartment just to raise money to send their children to study abroad.

passage.zh: I 據中國社會科學研究院統計，2010 年間赴外求學的中國學子中，有三分之一來自勞工階級家庭， II 他們的父母將其最後的資源都擠了出來，全盤賭在了孩子身上。
passage.py: I jù Zhōngguó Shèhuìkēxué yánjiūyuàn tǒngjì, 2010 niánjiān fù wài qiúxué de Zhōngguó xuézǐ zhōng, yǒu sānfēnzhīyī láizì láogōngjiējí jiātíng, II tāmen de fùmǔ jiāng qí zuìhòu de zīyuán dōu jǐ le chūlái, quánpán dǔzài le háizi shēnshàng.
passage.en: ___I___ According to the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, a third of the Chinese students who went abroad to study in 2010 came from working-class families; ___II___ their parents squeezed out their last resources and bet everything on their children.

passage.zh: 這也意味著， III 這批年輕人畢業後，將面臨極大的就業壓力。
passage.py: Zhè yě yìwèizhù, III zhè pī niánqīngrén bìyè hòu, jiāng miànlín jídà de jiùyè yālì.
passage.en: This also means that ___III___ these young people will face enormous employment pressure after graduating.

passage.zh: 而在現今畢業生人數衝破七百萬的同時， IV 許多高學歷畢業生只能屈就於以普通大學文憑為門檻的工作，面臨高不成低不就的求職處境。
passage.py: Ér zài xiànjīn bìyèshēng rénshù chōngpò qībǎiwàn de tóngshí, IV xǔduō gāoxuélì bìyèshēng zhǐnéng Qūjiùyú yǐ Pǔtōng dàxué wénpíng wèi ménkǎn de gōngzuò, miànlín gāobùchéngdībújiù de qiúzhí chǔjìng.
passage.en: And now, with the number of graduates exceeding seven million, ___IV___ many highly educated graduates can only settle for jobs that require an ordinary university degree, finding themselves unable to get the jobs they want and unwilling to take the ones they can get.

passage.zh: 如此看來，這種為了不輸在起跑點上的義無反顧，實在有些得不償失。
passage.py: Rúcǐ kànlái, zhèzhǒng wèile bù shū zài qǐpǎodiǎn shàng de yìwúfǎngù, shízài yǒuxiē débùchángshī.
passage.en: Seen this way, this all-out effort so as not to lose at the starting line really costs more than it gains.

passage.zh: 要想減緩這股教育狂熱談何容易，它深植於東亞文化圈的思維與文化之中，並與亞洲的就業模式互為表裡。
passage.py: Yào xiǎng jiǎnhuǎn zhè gǔ jiàoyù kuángrè tánhéróngyì, tā shēnzhí yú Dōngyà Wénhuàquān de sīwéi yǔ wénhuà zhīzhōng, bìng yǔ Yàzhōu de jiùyè móshì hùwéibiǎolǐ.
passage.en: Easing this education fever is far from easy: it is deeply rooted in the thinking and culture of East Asia and goes hand in hand with Asian employment patterns.

passage.zh: 倘若希望跳脫文憑主義的牢籠，恐怕只能仰賴亞洲企業主，主動破除學歷至上的就業文化，才能一改人們經年以來對於「崇尚文憑」的迷思。
passage.py: Tǎngruò xīwàng tiàotuō wénpíngzhǔyì de láolóng, kǒngpà zhǐnéng yǎnglài Yàzhōu qǐyèzhǔ, zhǔdòng pòchú xuélì zhìshàng de jiùyè wénhuà, cáinéng yī gǎi rénmen jīng nián yǐlái duìyú “Chóngshàng wénpíng” de mísī.
passage.en: If we want to break out of the cage of credentialism, I'm afraid we can only rely on Asian employers to take the initiative to break the employment culture that puts qualifications above all; only then can people's long-held myth of "worshipping diplomas" be changed.
